In accordance with FAR 10.001, market research was conducted to determine if sources capable of fulfilling the requirement for a commercially available UXG Agile Signal Generator and two Signal Studio software applications which meet the Government’s specifications exist. Additionally, market research was conducted to determine if the Government’s need can be met using any of the mandatory or non-mandatory sources listed at FAR 8.101 - 8.104. Based on market research, it was determined that Keysight and its authorized resellers/distributors are the only known vendors capable of meeting the Government’s specifications. In accordance with FAR 8.104, agencies are encouraged to consider satisfying requirements from or through non-mandatory sources, which includes the use of Federal Supply Schedules (e.g. GSA), before considering commercial sources in the open market. The Contract Specialist verified within GSA Advantage that the required items were not available via this source. Further, the Contract Specialist verified Keysight is not a NASA SEWP contract holder. Following this market research, the Contract Specialist also verified with Keysight’s point of c

he open market. The Contract Specialist verified within GSA Advantage that the required items were not available via this source. Further, the Contract Specialist verified Keysight is not a NASA SEWP contract holder. Following this market research, the Contract Specialist also verified with Keysight’s point of contact that Keysight is not a GSA Schedule or NASA SEWP contract holder on 15 JUL 2026. Since there are no vendors presently authorized to resell Keysight’s equipment via GSA, the Government intends to procure the required equipment on a brand name basis via SAM.gov. The Contract Specialist independently identified Keysight authorized resellers/distributors potentially able to deliver the Government’s requirement. Many of these authorized resellers/distributors have been used to successfully fulfill previous NRL requirements for similar equipment within TEWD. In accordance with FAR 8.104, agencies are encouraged to consider satisfying requirements from or through non-mandatory sources, which includes the use of Federal Supply Schedules (e.g. GSA), before considering commercial sources in the open market. The Contract Specialist verified within GSA Advantage that the required items were not available via this source. Further, the Contract Specialist verified Keysight is not a NASA SEWP contract holder. Following this market research, the Contract Specialist also verified with Keysight’s point of contact that Keysight is not a GSA Schedule or NASA SEWP contract holder on 15 JUL 2026. Since there are no vendors presently authorized to resell Keysight’s equipment via GSA, the Government intends to procure the required equipment on a brand name basis via SAM.gov. The Contract Specialist independently identified Keysight authorized resellers/distributors potentially able to deliver the Government’s requirement. Many of these authorized resellers/distributors have been used to successfully fulfill previous NRL requirements for similar equipment within TEWD. Additionally, identified several supplemental vendors capable of providing the required equipment.
